newsitem.title: USA: IRS proposes easing merger rules - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: IRS proposes easing merger rules - WSJ.

text.p: In a move that could spur merger activity, the Internal Revenue Service proposed rule changes that would make it easier for companies to make mergers and acquisitions through tax-free exchanges of shares, The Wall Street Journal reported Tuesday.
Tax authorities expect the changes to take place in June, the story says.

Acquiring companies will no longer need to ensure that shareholders who own at least five percent of the stock in an acquired company retain for as long as two years the new stock they receive in a tax-free merger, the story says.
